original.statement: Upgrading Crossplane to v2.0.0 requires executing the documented migration steps: adding the Crossplane Helm repository, upgrading via helm upgrade, and verifying the upgrade completion.

decision.reason: [ev-c28095f20093] contains only the generic upgrade procedure: add the Helm repository, run `helm upgrade` and check the pods. It doesn't say that any setting, resource or behaviour changed, and it doesn't name a v2-specific operator step beyond doing the upgrade itself. Treating "perform the upgrade" as a migration-required change would claim mandatory work the text doesn't support. No correct typed assertion follows from this excerpt.
